CRIME RES.
11. 9. 37
Alo

Suspected unauthorised wireless station
reported by British Military Authorities.

At 7.16p.m. 10/9/37, Capt. Sandie, Loyal Regt.,
Commanding Officer of the Left Company "D" area, with
headquarters at 7 Columbia Road, telephoned to the
station and requested the services of a detective.

Remarks on original.
1) Ag. C.P.
   Information.
   S.C.Y. 11/9
2) C.D.I.Ross,
   Enq.
   S.C.Y. 11/9
3) Important.
   K.M.B. 11/9
4) S.I.
   Report please.
   D.B.R. 12/9
5) Noted.
   W.L. 13/9.

D.S. Weed and C.D.C. 207 immediately attended and
interviewed Capt. Sandie, who stated that it had been
reported to him by Sgt. Yates, that a wireless station
near the British Military Post on Columbia Road, had
been sending out messages and that Sgt. Yates had
enquired and ascertained that several Chinese and one
American were the occupants of the house. He also
stated that a Sikh Watchman was employed there.

On receipt of the above, detectives made discreet
enquiries and found that the house in question was No.
7 Columbia Road and is situated at the end of a
terrace of 6 similar houses, leading off the road.

Sgt. Yates of the Loyal Regt. was interviewed at
the request of Capt. Sandie, and stated that he had
been informed of the foregoing by a foreigner, of
German nationality, who stated that until 4/9/37 the
house in question had been unoccupied, and that since
it had been taken, the occupants had erected a large
wireless aerial, and had been heard sending out messages.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 11 SEP. 1937 POLICE BRANCH）
（批：Eng.）
（批：DC 11/9）

犯罪调查科。
1937年9月11日。
Alo

英国军方当局报告的涉嫌非法无线电台。

1937年9月10日下午7时16分，驻哥伦比亚路7号、负责“D”区左翼连队的忠诚团（Loyal Regt.）指挥官桑迪上尉（Capt. Sandie）致电本捕房，请求派遣一名侦探。

原件批注。
1) 代理警务处长。
   知悉。
   S.C.Y. 9月11日
2) 副督察罗斯（C.D.I. Ross），
   查询。
   S.C.Y. 9月11日
3) 重要。
   K.M.B. 9月11日
4) 高级督察（S.I.）。
   请报告。
   D.B.R. 9月12日
5) 已阅。
   W.L. 9月13日。

警佐威德（D.S. Weed）和刑事侦缉队207号警员立即前往，会见了桑迪上尉。桑迪上尉称，耶茨中士（Sgt. Yates）向他报告，位于哥伦比亚路英军哨所附近的一处无线电台一直在发送讯息；耶茨中士经查询查明，该房屋内居住着几名中国人和一名美国人。他还称，那里雇佣了一名锡克族看守。

接到上述情况后，侦探们进行了谨慎的调查，发现涉案房屋为哥伦比亚路7号，位于从大路延伸出的一排6栋相似房屋的末端。

应桑迪上尉的要求，对忠诚团的耶茨中士进行了问询。耶茨中士称，上述情况是一名德国籍外国人告知他的。该外国人称，在1937年9月4日之前，该房屋一直无人居住；自被占用以来，居住者架设了一个大型无线电天线，并被人听到正在发送讯息。

（印：副处长 1937年9月11日 警务处）
（批：Eng.）
（批：DC 9月11日）

Remarks on original.    Further enquiries were made by the undersigned
                        at the address at 51 Columbia Road and it was ascer-
1) Ag. C.P.             tained that the house in question is at present occupied
      S.C.Y. 13/9       by the R.C.A. Communications, Inc.. The undersigned
                        interviewed Mr. G.F. Shecklen, vice-president of the
2) Sp. Br.              R.C.A., who was present at the time, and he stated that
      To see.           the company had occupied the premises from 2/9/37, and
      S.C.Y. 13/9       they had been testing the radio, pending transmitting
                        to U.S.A. and Manila. He further stated that it was
                        a Commercial Station and that they were licensed by the
                        Ministry of Communications, and that it was a substitute
                        for the station at Chenju.

                        Mr. Shecklen requested that the above information
                        be kept confidential.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No........... 807
S.I, Special Branch XXXX
REPORT
Date September 13, 1937.

Subject Suspected Unauthorised Wireless Station reported by
British Military Authorities
Made by D.S.I. Logan Forwarded by C Crawford

Reference the remarks of the Acting Commissioner of
Police and D.C. (Crime and Special Branches) appended on
Bubbling Well Station report on above, Misc. 256/37, dated
September 10 and September 11 respectively, no information
further than that contained in attached reports has been
obtained. The wave length over which this Station broadcasts
is known to the undersigned but is being kept confidential
at the request of Mr. Shecklen of R.C.A. Communications, Inc.
It is suggested that in order to check the claim that the
Station is being used purely for commercial purposes,
arrangements might be made whereby the officer in charge
of C.C.R. could listen in to this Station's broadcasts.

W Logan
D. S. I.

（左侧批注：24R. 13/9）
